selected_need: Make accepted QIF v0.2 runtime schemas and verifier rules executable for v0.2.1
intended_user_or_segment: QIF maintainers, auditors, and AI review agents
context_summary: Current runtime hardening separates conceptual entities; this slice must make records structured enough for schema validation and verifier execution.
hypothesis: First-class Raw Expert Answers, Question Log Entries, derivation records, structured applicability conditions, confidence policies, and governance events will remove replay ambiguity without redesigning QIF.
rejected_alternatives: Do not use free-text selection logic as the only source of applicability truth.
explicit_risks: Overfitting schema rules could make the framework less domain-general; use structured conditions with domain-neutral names.
delivery_validation_requirements: Run npm test plus AOF review and organization verification.
need: Strengthen implementation traceability and executable verifier rules.
intent: Make QIF v0.2.1 packages replayable from raw answer through extraction, derivation, applicability, review, governance, and confidence policy.
context: No UI, no external integration, no software-only assumptions, no semantic-truth claim.
